description: Declare a Snowflake OpenFlow process group as an external Dagster asset. Pair with snowflake_openflow_status_sensor to materialize on completion.

asset_key.description: Dagster asset key (e.g. 'snowflake/openflow/customer_sync') for a single flow. Mutually exclusive with `flows:` -- use this (with `flow_name:`) for one flow, or `flows:` to declare several from one component instance.
asset_key.label: Asset Key

flow_name.label: Flow Name
flow_name.description: OpenFlow process-group name for a single flow. Mutually exclusive with `flows:`.

flows.description: Declare several OpenFlow process groups as external assets from one component instance, instead of one block per flow. Each entry: `key` (Dagster asset key, required), `flow_name` (OpenFlow process-group name, required), plus optional `runtime_id`, `deps`, `owners`, `tags`, `kinds`, `group_name`, `description`. Mutually exclusive with the top-level `asset_key`/`flow_name` fields.
flows.label: Flows

runtime_id.description: OpenFlow runtime id (optional metadata). Single-flow mode only.
runtime_id.label: Runtime ID

name: External Snowflake OpenFlow Flow Asset
